subject: Champion roster & executive briefing schedule — CloudCore close plan
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudcore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Champion roster & executive briefing schedule — CloudCore close plan

Samir —

Thanks again for the thorough demo last week. Team CloudCore is squarely on our Q4 pipeline for the platform pilot; to keep momentum we want to lock the mutual action plan (MAP) and a short executive briefing (30–45m) with your C-suite next week. High level asks from our side:

- Confirm one exec (CIO/CTO/CFO) who can attend the EB.
- Sign off on the MAP milestones and target close week (we're proposing week of Oct 9).
- Provide availability windows for a 30–45 minute EB (we can host or join your office).

I've attached a draft MAP (CloudCore_MAP_v4.xlsx) and a one-pager EB agenda. Proposed attendees from Redwood: myself (AE), Marissa Cole (CS lead), Ben Carter (Solutions Architect).

Can you confirm the exec point-person and a couple of windows (PST preferred)? If it helps we can propose two slots and you can pick.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.com]
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: CloudCore_MAP_v4.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudcore.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah O'Connor <leah.oconnor@cloudcore.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Sep 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Champion roster & executive briefing schedule — CloudCore close plan

Jasmine —

Thanks for the materials. Quick answers:

- Exec lead: Leah O'Connor (VP Product & Cloud Strategy) will join the EB. She is the overarching sponsor for this initiative.
- Target close: Oct 13–20 is ideal for internal procurement alignment.
- Availability for EB: Oct 3 (afternoon PST) or Oct 5 (early morning PST) both work; Leah prefers the 30–45m slot.

Please send a proposed agenda and confirm Redwood attendees. I'll circulate to Leah and our procurement lead after we lock the time.

Samir
Head of Platform Partnerships, CloudCore
[samir.patel@cloudcore.com]

Subject: Fwd: Champion roster & executive briefing schedule — CloudCore close plan

Team — looping you in. Samir confirmed Leah as exec sponsor and gave two EB windows (Oct 3 PM PST or Oct 5 AM PST). Target close range Oct 13–20.

Action items: 
- Marissa: I need the quick 4-slide EB agenda and a 30–45m run-of-show that highlights procurement milestones and our risk mitigations. Attach to the invite.
- Ben: please prepare a 10-minute technical appendix covering private deployment options (VPC/KMS) + latency SLOs — Leah will likely ask about data residency.
- Karthik: help me craft the MAP milestones with procurement gating tasks; Samir wants the MAP locked so they can align procurement.

I'll draft two invites and send both options to Samir for pick.

-Jasmine
